'''M'Nes''' ('''"True Faith"''') was the dominant religion on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Started by [[j'ber V'Sook]] in the years after [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]], the philosophy spread across the planet.
